The protocol was revised during A training at additional595/absolute5595. Old protocols, native_geometry_v1, checkpoint595 and source hashes are retained under migrations/ and repairs/. Existing committed updates were not restarted.
The development stopping statistic is the mean over QP0/5/9 of equal32-video FloLPIPS means divided by the same-QP parent5000 means. Mode min, absolute normalized min_delta0.005,patience3. Baseline does not count as a patience check. best_raw and improvement_anchor are distinct. Exact ties retain the earlier checkpoint.
K_common is the largest intersection of completed planned validation steps and is independent of performance gaps. A/B dev-best comparisons may use unequal training budgets and are labeled separately. The final model manifest was frozen before new test evaluation; identical model states are deduplicated.
FloLPIPS dev-best does not assert optimality on other metrics. Legal early stopping does not establish convergence or effectiveness. No scientific interpretation, BD-rate extrapolation or new hyperparameter search is provided.
Training prefix, actual visited identities/windows/ULong sample counts and coverage fractions are reported above; incomplete expanded-pool coverage is not called full-data training. Allocation time is observed wall time multiplied by assigned physical cards, not kernel-active time.
PWC sampler remains pixel-center grid/align_corners=False/W−1/H−1 flow normalization/invalid-zero/full-image denominator; width11 dx1 means1.1 sampling pixels. No exact S2VC implementation reproduction claim.
GT flow is offline-only; raw independent decoder tensors produce neural metrics, local JPEGs are viewing previews only. Each unique model/video/QP point has its own fresh RANS stream and independent decoder. Actual rates are retained; no equal-rate claim is inferred from equal QP.
Historical13 references are separate from new_holdout_test32. Parent156 GT-flow reused scores are preserved separately and were not used as the new development baseline.
Directory initialization and native-geometry metadata repair history: ENGINEERING_REPAIR.md. The original source/data assertions and1e-3 numerical criteria were retained. Old source/protocol snapshots are not relabeled as v3 passes.
